crash_reporter.heading: Clash Nyanpasu ran into a problem and closed
crash_reporter.description: Send this report on GitHub to help us fix it.
crash_reporter.copy_failed: Could not copy the report; select it and copy it by hand
crash_reporter.issue_opened: Issue page opened. Drag the diagnostics archive into the issue to attach the logs.
crash_reporter.open_failed: Could not open the issue page
crash_reporter.manual_description: Describe the problem on GitHub to help us fix it.
crash_reporter.failed: Some diagnostics could not be collected

dialog.panic: Please report this issue to Github issue tracker.
dialog.migrate:

WARNING: This will override your current config if exists
dialog.custom_app_dir_migrate:
You will set custom app dir to %{path}
Shall we move the current app dir to the new one?

warning.enable_tun_with_no_permission: TUN mode requires admin permission or service mode, neither is enabled, TUN mode will not work properly.

info.grant_core_permission:
Clash core needs admin permission to make TUN mode work properly, grant it?
Please note that this operation requires password input.

startup_failure.unresolved_path: Path could not be resolved; see details below.
startup_failure.heading: Startup failed

directories.recovery: Check permissions and free disk space. Move a portable installation to a writable location.

migration_failed.description: The configuration migration could not finish.
migration_failed.recovery: Correct the reported problem, or restore your configuration from an available backup.

newer_version.description: These files were written by a newer version.
newer_version.recovery: Install a newer version of Clash Nyanpasu, or restore a compatible backup.

user_config.description: A configuration file could not be read or validated.
user_config.recovery: Correct the file shown below, or restore it from the backups folder.

core_runtime_directory.description: The core runtime directory is unavailable.
core_runtime_directory.recovery: Exit all Clash Nyanpasu processes before removing this directory, then restart. Check its permissions first.

jobs_database.recovery: This file stores only task history. You can delete or move jobs.redb, then restart.

web_view2.recovery: Download the portable package again, or reinstall Clash Nyanpasu.

logging.recovery: Check permissions and free disk space at the log location.

permission.description: Access to a required file or directory was denied.
permission.recovery: Check permissions for the path below and ensure your account can read and write it.

busy.description: A required file or directory is busy.
busy.recovery: Exit other Clash Nyanpasu processes and release the file lock, then restart.

internal.recovery: Copy the details and submit an issue with the version and logs.
